question: Where is the nearest nature reserve ahead of AHN Cancer Institute, Erie, PA toward Hooks Gallery, Fairview, PA?
sql: WITH start_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%AHN Cancer Institute%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Erie%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hooks Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Fairview%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), target_bearing_info AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, e.geometry)) AS target_azimuth_deg, s.geometry AS start_geom FROM start_poi s, end_poi e ) SELECT p.park_name FROM parks p, target_bearing_info tbi WHERE p.leisure = 'nature_reserve' -- Ensure the nature reserve is not too close to the starting point (e.g., within 10 meters) AND ST_Distance(tbi.start_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) > 10 -- Filter by direction: within +/- 45 degrees of the target bearing AND LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(tbi.start_geom, ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) - tbi.target_azimuth_deg), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(tbi.start_geom, ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) - tbi.target_azimuth_deg) ) <= 45 ORDER BY ST_Distance(tbi.start_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
